The patcher now checks for updates automatically when opened, downloads and verifies new releases in the background, and offers installation in a themed prompt. Choose Later to continue and be reminded next time you open it. Android still confirms installation.

Removed the manual check, download, and install update buttons and the automatic-update toggle. Patch availability is also checked automatically on startup; preparing the app fetches the latest compatible patches. Offline checks leave the patcher usable.

Includes patch v0.4.3; no patch changes. Update the patcher in place to preserve your device signing key and prepared app data.
